# Data
demandI = [10000, 10000, 12000, 12000, 16000, 16000, 20000, 20000]
demandII = [6000, 7200, 8400, 10800, 10800, 12000, 12000, 12000]
prodI_rate = 10
prodII_rate = 6
normal_hours = 40
overtime_hours = 60
wage_skilled = 360
wage_overtime = 540
wage_trainee = 120
wage_new = 240
penaltyI = 0.5
penaltyII = 0.6
train_cap = 3
total_skilled = 50
total_new_needed = 50
W = 8

m = Model()
m.hideOutput()
m.setRealParam("limits/time", 570)

# Decision variables
# T[t]: skilled workers starting training in week t+1 (0-indexed), t=0..6
T = [m.addVar(vtype="I", lb=0, ub=total_skilled, name=f"T_{t}") for t in range(W - 1)]

# Worker allocation per week (0-indexed t=0..7)
nI = [m.addVar(vtype="I", lb=0, name=f"nI_{t}") for t in range(W)]
nII = [m.addVar(vtype="I", lb=0, name=f"nII_{t}") for t in range(W)]
oI = [m.addVar(vtype="I", lb=0, name=f"oI_{t}") for t in range(W)]
oII = [m.addVar(vtype="I", lb=0, name=f"oII_{t}") for t in range(W)]
nI_n = [m.addVar(vtype="I", lb=0, name=f"nI_n_{t}") for t in range(W)]
nII_n = [m.addVar(vtype="I", lb=0, name=f"nII_n_{t}") for t in range(W)]
oI_n = [m.addVar(vtype="I", lb=0, name=f"oI_n_{t}") for t in range(W)]
oII_n = [m.addVar(vtype="I", lb=0, name=f"oII_n_{t}") for t in range(W)]

# Backlog (continuous, >= 0)
dI = [m.addVar(vtype="C", lb=0, name=f"dI_{t}") for t in range(W)]
dII = [m.addVar(vtype="C", lb=0, name=f"dII_{t}") for t in range(W)]


def in_training(t):
    """Number of skilled workers in training during week t (0-indexed)."""
    if t == 0:
        return T[0]
    elif t <= W - 2:
        return T[t] + T[t - 1]
    else:
        return T[t - 1]


def new_available(t):
    """Number of newly-trained workers available in week t (0-indexed)."""
    if t < 2:
        return 0
    else:
        return quicksum(train_cap * T[s] for s in range(0, t - 1))


# Constraints
for t in range(W):
    it = in_training(t)
    na = new_available(t)

    # All original skilled workers must be assigned (production or training)
    m.addCons(nI[t] + nII[t] + oI[t] + oII[t] == total_skilled - it, name=f"alloc_orig_{t}")

    # All new workers must be assigned to production
    m.addCons(nI_n[t] + nII_n[t] + oI_n[t] + oII_n[t] == na, name=f"alloc_new_{t}")

    # Production in week t
    prodI_t = (prodI_rate * normal_hours * (nI[t] + nI_n[t])
               + prodI_rate * overtime_hours * (oI[t] + oI_n[t]))
    prodII_t = (prodII_rate * normal_hours * (nII[t] + nII_n[t])
                + prodII_rate * overtime_hours * (oII[t] + oII_n[t]))

    # Backlog (inequality to allow overproduction)
    if t == 0:
        m.addCons(dI[t] >= demandI[t] - prodI_t, name=f"backlog_I_{t}")
        m.addCons(dII[t] >= demandII[t] - prodII_t, name=f"backlog_II_{t}")
    else:
        m.addCons(dI[t] >= dI[t - 1] + demandI[t] - prodI_t, name=f"backlog_I_{t}")
        m.addCons(dII[t] >= dII[t - 1] + demandII[t] - prodII_t, name=f"backlog_II_{t}")

# Training requirement: at least 50 new workers trained by end of week 8
m.addCons(quicksum(train_cap * T[t] for t in range(W - 1)) >= total_new_needed, name="train_req")

# Objective: minimize total cost (wages + penalties)
obj_terms = []
for t in range(W):
    it = in_training(t)

    # Original skilled workers: normal production
    obj_terms.append(wage_skilled * (nI[t] + nII[t]))
    # Original skilled workers: overtime production
    obj_terms.append(wage_overtime * (oI[t] + oII[t]))
    # Original skilled workers: in training
    obj_terms.append(wage_skilled * it)
    # New workers: normal production
    obj_terms.append(wage_new * (nI_n[t] + nII_n[t]))
    # New workers: overtime production
    obj_terms.append(wage_overtime * (oI_n[t] + oII_n[t]))
    # Trainees during training period
    obj_terms.append(wage_trainee * train_cap * it)
    # Late delivery penalties
    obj_terms.append(penaltyI * dI[t])
    obj_terms.append(penaltyII * dII[t])

m.setObjective(quicksum(obj_terms), "minimize")

m.optimize()

st = m.getStatus()
print(f"status: {st}")
if m.getNSols() > 0:
    print(f"objective: {m.getObjVal()}")

F = [m.addVar(name=f"F_{t+1}", lb=0, ub=5000, vtype="I") for t in range(T)]
OT = [m.addVar(name=f"OT_{t+1}", lb=0, ub=100000, vtype="C") for t in range(T)]

prev_B = B0
for t in range(T):
    m.addCons(I[t] - B[t] == prev_I - prev_B + P[t] + O[t] - D[t], name=f"inv_balance_{t+1}")

    prev_B = B[t]

# Workforce balance constraints

    m.addCons(W[t] == prev_W + H[t] - F[t], name=f"workforce_balance_{t+1}")
    prev_W = W[t]

# Overtime limit constraints

m.addCons(B[T-1] == 0, name="terminal_backorder")

              + hire_cost * quicksum(H)
              + fire_cost * quicksum(F))

# Inventory carried over from stage j to stage j+1 (tools available but not used)
y = [m.addVar(vtype="I", lb=0, name=f"y_{j+1}") for j in range(n - 1)]  # y_1 .. y_9

obj = a * quicksum(x[j] for j in range(n)) + b * quicksum(s[j] for j in range(n - 1)) + c * quicksum(f[j] for j in range(n - 1))
m.setObjective(obj, "minimize")

for j in range(n - 1):
    m.addCons(s[j] + f[j] == r[j], name=f"repair_split_{j+1}")

# For stages 1..n-1: y[j] = available - r[j]  (excess tools carry over)
# For stage n: available >= r[n-1] (no carryover needed, tools discarded after)
for j in range(n):
    terms = [x[j]]
    if j >= 1:
        terms.append(y[j - 1])       # tools carried over from previous stage
    if j >= p:
        terms.append(s[j - p])       # slow repair: sent at end of stage (j-p+1), returns at stage (j+1)
    if j >= q:
        terms.append(f[j - q])       # fast repair: sent at end of stage (j-q+1), returns at stage (j+1)

        m.addCons(quicksum(terms) - r[j] == y[j], name=f"inventory_balance_{j+1}")
    else:

# Exactly one spare count per component

budget_expr = (quicksum(price[0] * j * y[0][j] for j in range(n_spares))
               + quicksum(price[1] * j * y[1][j] for j in range(n_spares))
               + quicksum(price[2] * j * y[2][j] for j in range(n_spares)))
m.addCons(budget_expr <= budget_limit, name="budget")

weight_expr = (quicksum(weight[0] * j * y[0][j] for j in range(n_spares))
               + quicksum(weight[1] * j * y[1][j] for j in range(n_spares))
               + quicksum(weight[2] * j * y[2][j] for j in range(n_spares)))
m.addCons(weight_expr <= weight_limit, name="weight")

        m.addCons(w[j][k] <= y[1][k], name=f"w_ub2_{j}_{k}")
